cases.contract: Td restores the line origin after Tj advances the text matrix.
layout_math: Font-size 40 advances A=24 and B=20 points.
First line origins (30,120),(54,120). Tj leaves text matrix advanced; Td uses text LINE matrix.
Td (0,-55) sets next line origin (30,65); BA origins (30,65),(50,65).

cases.contract: Independent default/Tc/Tw controls distinguish character advancement from single-byte space advancement.
layout_math: Default AB origins x=30,54 at y=130.
Tc=3 makes AB origins x=30,57 at y=80.
With Tc=3,Tw=7, A-space-B gives B x=30+(24+3)+(10+3+7)=77 at y=30.

cases.contract: Tm rotates glyph shape/advance, then replaces both text matrices with a new ordinary matrix.

Replacement Tm [1,0,0,1,30,120] sets BA origins (30,120),(50,120). It does not concatenate.
